messages:
alexa: quick q — propose adding an 'SLO trigger' option to the Notify builder so teams can pick SLOs (error_rate, latency_p99) as alert thresholds. thoughts? :thinking_face:

mattw: +1. we'll need an API shape under /v1/notify-rules. my suggestion: `condition.type = \"slo\"` and `condition.selector = {slo_id: \"...\", metric: \"error_rate\", window: \"5m\"}`

sana: can we avoid per-event fanout? if lots of tenants enable SLO triggers we could overwhelm the eval service. suggest server-side scheduled evals and rely on sampling/bucketing so we don't compute per-request.

jules: also need quota gating — SLO-evals should count against a notify-eval budget (not API tokens). otherwise ops will be flooded. add `eval_cost` metadata and cap per-tenant.

alexa: good call. proposed rule: server evals run at 1m granularity with exponential backoff for flapping signals. console shows \"estimated evals/day\" when you pick an SLO.

mattw: API sketch:
```
POST /v1/notify-rules
{
  \"name\": \"ErrorRate SLO breach\",
  \"condition\": {\"type\": \"slo\", \"slo_id\": \"slo_123\", \"metric\": \"error_rate\", \"threshold_pct\": 0.01, \"window\": \"5m\"},
  \"notify\": {\"channels\": [\"pagerduty\"], \"escalation\": \"default\"}
}
```

sana: telemetry: emit `notify.rule.created` with `condition.type`, `slo_id` and `estimated_eval_per_day`. emit `notify.eval.result` with `slo_id`, `fired` boolean, and `eval_latency_ms`.

jules: agree. also emit `notify.eval.suppressed_reason` when we drop due to noise suppression or quota.

deploy-bot: CI: api + console feature branch build succeeded: https://ci.redwood/1234 :white_check_mark:

alexa: UX notes: show a compact badge on the SLO selector: \"Est. evals/day: 24 — cost: low\" and include a toggle \"Apply noise suppression\" default ON. show cost estimate tooltip that expands into a small breakdown.

mattw: migration plan: existing metric-based thresholds map to `condition.type = \"metric\"` and keep current behavior. `type = \"slo\"` is opt-in only.

sana: request a feature flag `slo-notify-eval-v1` so we can canary to 10% of tenants and watch fanout.

alexa: action items:
- mattw: open API PR + draft migration doc
- sana: add telemetry events + quota counters
- jules: design quota gating + suppression heuristics
- alexa: console mocks + rollout plan + feature flag

alexa: tagging @eng-sre for runbook updates and @product for PM sign-off

alerts-bot: created linked issue: https://rwd/issue/4452 (SLO-based notify rules) assigned to mattw

jules: nit: ensure `estimated_eval_per_day` calculation takes the tenant's SLO resolution and retention into account; don't assume 1m for everyone.

mattw: noted, will include formula in PR and surface an estimate column from billing API.

sana: can we add a small stress harness in eng-ml to simulate heavy SLO fanout? happy to help with load profiles.

alexa: awesome — we'll sync Tue 10am to review PRs and telemetry. :calendar:
